findings.claim: `/` links now have a defined meaning: in docs/ they resolve from the repository root, as GitHub renders them; in .okf/ they resolve from the bundle root (OKF §6.1) and are left to the validator.

The plan leaves in-bundle .okf/ links to the okf validator, which only warns as §6.1 requires, and fails only on docs/ links and .okf/ links that leave the bundle. A test checks that a broken in-bundle link is not reported.
